# Barbell plate calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/plate-calculator/

Find equal plates for each side of a barbell from your available inventory. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Load a 20 kg bar toward an 80 kg total using plates available as pairs.

## Limits and checks

Inventory quantities are pairs, one plate per side. The tool reports any difference between the requested and attainable load.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
